fixed_strings.description: Treat `pattern` as a literal substring rather than a regex.

exclude_globs.description: Glob patterns to exclude from the search after root and include-glob filtering.

max_line_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes returned for each matched or context line. Long matched lines are clipped around the first match; context lines are prefix-clipped.

ignore_policy.description: How much of the ignore stack applies. `none` walks everything; `builtin` applies Harn's built-in directory defaults; `project` adds `.gitignore`, `.ignore`, and `.agentignore`.
